sources.title: 死神と少女 攻略 全EDルート フルコンプまで — ちま
sources.notes: Independent 2011 full-ending written walkthrough. Full text surfaced in web search; direct page access currently redirects in a loop. Hinase successful はい path and comment documenting alternate いいえ with different preceding choice state. PSP-era, supplementary only, not exact Switch Set B.

disagreements:
両日本語セットはNintendo Switch/Vita対応を明記し、主なルート構造と攻略順は一致する。一方、共通部には literal choice の差（例：Set Aの『袴姿の青年を気にする／死神に関して質問する』に対しSet Bの『先程の声を気にする／目の前の人物を疑う』）や、日生・桐島系で好感度調整用の選択肢差がある。route生成では同一イベントの別選択点か単なる別の成功経路かを各章で照合し、片方の文言を他方へコピーしない。主ルート分岐・終幕は両セットで独立確認済み。Switch版は公式ページで対象を固定し、choroはSwitch版追加要素なしと記載。各portraitはSet A個別攻略ページ上でキャラクター名と並んで表示された画像URLを直接開いて照合済み。 日生ルートの共有SAVE位置にも差がある。Set Aは「日生の意見に乗る」の直前に★日生・桐島・十夜 共通SAVEを置く一方、Set Bは「日生の事を考える」の後／「気になる先輩」の前に光・七葵・十夜共通SAVEを置く。保存位置が食い違うため、規約どおり早いSet A位置を採用し、そのsave stepのjpGuide2は第二ガイド未記載プレースホルダーとする。Set Bの遅いSAVE位置は研究差異として保持し、別SAVEとして重複生成しない。

2026-10-13 unresolved exact-target choices: Hinase Set A (https://www.soregashi.work/entry/shinigami-hinase-kouryaku) uses はい after 後を追いかける, while Set B (https://choro-game.com/blog-entry-2949.html) uses いいえ. Independent Switch-compatible corroboration (https://maistar.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-6492.html) also uses いいえ, but its preceding choices differ. Save 6 is now before the chase; the exact post-load choice outcome is still unverified. Chiyo Set A (https://www.soregashi.work/entry/shinigami-kirishima_chiyo-kouryaku) uses いいえ after 千代の名を呼ぶ, while Set B (https://choro-game.com/blog-entry-2959.html) uses はい. Independent Switch-compatible corroboration (https://maistar.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-6493.html) also uses はい, but the preceding chapter choices and saved states differ. Preserve the source-lane disagreement. Neither choice has a verified shared saved-state outcome, nor a repository-owner-approved exception; keep Hinase/Chiyo accuracy blocked, reviewed:false, pending exact-state evidence or owner approval.

2026-10-13 additional independent Vita-only source: mizukinoko's 2019 full-route walkthroughs (https://plaza.rakuten.co.jp/mizukinoko/diary/201909170000/ and https://plaza.rakuten.co.jp/mizukinoko/diary/201909180000/) directly show Hinase 後を追いかける → いいえ → 日生-結末, supporting Set B's literal at that decision, and Chiyo 千代の名を呼ぶ → いいえ → 千代-結末, supporting Set A's literal. This demonstrates that independently documented successful paths use both answers across different walkthrough states, rather than resolving either exact Switch saved-state discrepancy. Source identifies Vita only; no exact Switch same-state test. Both blockers remain; no owner exception.

2026-10-13 HalfAdder (https://half-a.net/games1/shinigami.html), independently inspected Japanese walkthrough with unspecified platform: Hinase 後を追いかける→いいえ→GOODEND; Chiyo 千代の名を呼ぶ→いいえ→千代GOODEND. Different preceding decisions prevent a same-state Switch equivalence claim. choro's Switch/Vita hub documents flowchart restart parameter adjustment, which may explain differing outcomes but is not proven here. Both accuracy blockers and reviewed:false remain; no owner exception.

2026-10-23 Kirishima final sequence: Set A (https://www.soregashi.work/entry/shinigami-kirishima_chiyo-kouryaku) prints 迷惑ではない → 桐島先輩の名を呼ぶ → いいえ → はい → 更に名前を呼ぶ → 桐島-結末. Set B (https://choro-game.com/blog-entry-2959.html) prints 迷惑ではない → いいえ → はい → 更に名前を呼ぶ → 七葵エンド. The four shared decision events are independently documented and now transcribed in both route source lanes; Set A's additional 桐島先輩の名を呼ぶ is absent from Set B, so its jpGuide2 stays the omission placeholder. The walkthroughs use different preceding chapter decisions; this does not prove the additional prompt appears in the identical Switch state. Keep this source-gate qualification visible for independent accuracy review; do not infer same-state equivalence.

2026-11-04 bilingual source-search audit: New source_search records actual JP/EN searches and candidate independence/edition classifications. The unresolved exact-state findings remain material; verification_tier=blocked until independent same-state evidence or scoped owner sign-off. English translated/Choro-derived walkthroughs are not independent E.

2026-11-09 third-source conflict reconciliation (owner instruction; companion policy PR #117): H1: retain the entire Set-A success route to avoid mixing different prior states; Set A documents 後を追いかける→はい→王子様は王子様だ→行く and an independently authored 2011 ちま full-ending chart also prints はい on a successful prior-state path. Set B, maistar, and HalfAdder print いいえ with different preceding sequences, so their success is compatible with a state-dependent choice. C1: Set A's Save9 branch 千代の名を呼ぶ→いいえ→自分から話を切り出す is independently corroborated locally by HalfAdder and older Vita-specific mizukinoko; B and maistar take はい on other chapter/save prefixes. K1: A prints 桐島先輩の名を呼ぶ between 迷惑ではない and いいえ, while B/maistar/HalfAdder omit the prompt on successful alternate route states. Follow it if shown, otherwise continue with all-three documented いいえ→はい→更に名前を呼ぶ. These are bounded, source-backed author choices and a conditional, not a claim of identical saved-state Switch captures or independent review PASS. The exact pinned Switch target and all verbatim A/B source text remain unchanged. Changes to research invalidate the prior research-blob-bound accuracy records; fresh independent reviews are required. ちま directly indexed full text cannot currently be opened due to redirect loop, so it is a supplemental older-source outcome witness, not an exact-release independent primary set.

2026-11-10 AUTHOR RESPONSE to independent accuracy CHANGES REQUESTED (review of research blob c7c4a2c8d893340aeb04371024e55784b76b1808): The November 9 author reconciliation is an explicitly PROVISIONAL route-selection hypothesis, not a verified same-state Switch outcome. It does not supersede the earlier material H1/C1/K1 blocker paragraphs. H1: the complete Set-A route is transcribed but independent B and auxiliary sources do not establish that the selected はい works from the guide's identical saved state. C1: independent local いいえ corroboration has differing earlier state and does not establish the exact Save9 outcome. K1: 'if prompted' is an unverified player-facing contingency, not a documented triggering mechanic. The 2011 chima source was not directly inspectable and cannot count as exact-target evidence. The accurate gate is BLOCKED (not dual_verified) pending a directly inspected exact-target same-state executable path, documented triggering condition, or valid owner-approved scoped exception under merged main standards. Two independent Japanese walkthroughs were located and English searched without a qualifying independent exact-target walkthrough; their existence alone does not cure material contradictions. Preserve all literal Set A/B fields and route files; no reviewed:true or self-approval. PR #117 is unmerged and is not invoked as governing policy.
